identificationModule.officialTitle: A Treatment Continuation Study for Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis/Motor Neuron Disease Who Have Successfully Completed Study CMD-2016-001

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Treatment extension study for ALS/MND patients who participated in phase 1 study CMD-2016-001, completed assessments following six 28-day cycles of treatment, and whom the Investigator considers would benefit from continued CuATSM treatment.

identificationModule.briefTitle: CuATSM Compared With Placebo for Treatment of ALS/MND
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase 2 Study of Cu(II)ATSM in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis/Motor Neuron Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo controlled study to assess the tolerabilty and efficacy of CuATSM in patients with ALS/MND. Patients will be randomized 1:1 to CuATSM or placebo for 6 x 28-day cycles (24 weeks) of treatment.

identificationModule.briefTitle: Treatment Continuation Study for Patients With ALS/MND Who Completed Study CMD-2019-001
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Treatment Continuation Study for Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis/Motor Neuron Disease Who Have Successfully Complete Study CMD-2019-001

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Provides up to six months treatment with CuATSM for subjects who have successfully completed study CMD-2019-001

identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 1 Single and Multiple Dose Escalation and Pharmacokinetic Study of Cu(II)ATSM Administered Orally to Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis/Motor Neuron Disease

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Multicenter, open-label , single and multiple dose-escalation and pharmacokinetic study
